text.insert: Current decisions lead this record. Older alternatives remain only in the history table so readers can identify superseded contracts without mistaking them for active design.

props.title: Current decisions
rows: Learning authorship
The librarian derives attempts and learnings from transcripts, checkpoints, PRs, and Discord; workers do not author a separate knowledge report.
Corroboration
The librarian judges consistency of evidence; there is no fixed confirmation count.
Graduation
Name proposals remain internal and do not automatically enter upstream PRs.
Call edges
CALLS and data-reference edges derive from symbolized disassembly, with Ghidra xrefs as an independent cross-check.
Mismatch vocabulary
Ten stable categories are controlled; signatures remain searchable free text until evidence supports promotion.
Negative tactics
Every attempted tactic receives failed, partial, or success outcome and a timestamp.
Sibling rules
Melee-specific naming rules live as game configuration consumed by a generic builder.
Crosswalk scope
Mechanical wiki mappings cover ft, gr, and it families; weaker families remain excluded.
Boot context
Workers receive a minimal target card and traverse pointers for details.
Rebuild cadence
Worker completion triggers incremental maintenance; complete index builds occur at epoch boundaries.
Historical intake
Discord, past PRs, and worker history use a present-anchored backfill through the librarian.
Ledger storage
An append log is acceptable only with a first-class searchable index; search quality governs storage.
Transcript retention
Full transcripts remain available for analysis after condensation and may be pruned later.
Attempt substrate
worker_checkpoints are the observed-attempt authority; librarian output overlays tactics and interpretation.
Knowledge agent
One librarian owns condense, curation, and PR-indexing doors with typed batch items.
Librarian tools
Every door can search code graph, past PRs, SmashWiki, and the ledger itself.
Job state
Knowledge jobs use queued, waiting, claimed, running, succeeded, failed, or cancelled; processing is not a status.

props.title: Decision record history
rows: Backfill execution closed the remaining source-batching, worker-scope, Discord-tool, and concurrency questions.
One librarian replaced curator and PR-indexer roles; typed doors, present anchoring, search-first storage, and epoch rebuild contracts were fixed.
Asm-derived call edges replaced the earlier heuristic-first option; graduation was deferred and librarian judgment replaced fixed corroboration counts.
The model converged on evidence-backed learnings, graded attempts, target-anchored stores, and a searchable ledger.
